test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All jugs are cups.

2. All cups are espressos.

3. Some jugs are saucers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some espressos are saucers.

II. Some cups are jugs.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follow

solution:
Statements:

1. All jugs are cups.

2. All cups are espressos.

3. Some jugs are saucers.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66a1b325050617d695340a81e754976114874bdf7dfa43d21ea4e35c6cee0ec1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some espressos are saucers → **Follows **(Because all jugs are cups, all cups are espressos and some jugs are saucers, so some espressos will be saucers is definite).

II. Some cups are jugs → **Follows **(Since all jugs are cups, some jugs being cups is obvious and definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow"**.
